description: Summary of ALL currently active Amtrak trains grouped by route — "how many Amtrak trains are running right now", "which Amtrak routes have delays", national system overview. Returns per route: active train count, train numbers, and the worst delay in minutes. Compact; live from a community mirror of Amtrak's tracking feed. Example: amtrak_routes_active({})
name: amtrak_routes_active
